risk_if_not_implemented: Without Generative Artificial Intelligence (GAI) Identification, AI and autonomous systems may produce unreliable, biased or unsafe outputs, act outside authorized scope, or expose sensitive data. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Loss of Authenticity / Provenance (R-IP-5), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9), Artificial Intelligence & Autonomous Technologies (AAT) System Failure or Unintended Behavior (MT-13), Adversarial Artificial Intelligence (AI) Attack (MT-29).

compensating_control_1.name: Penetration Testing
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to conduct penetration testing on Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS).
compensating_control_1.justification: Penetration Testing (VPM-18) provides periodic assessment and assurance that compensates for the absence of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GAI) Identification (AAT-27.1) by providing structured evaluation of the environment to surface gaps and verify residual control effectiveness. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Artificial Intelligence Test, Evaluation, Validation & Verification (AI TEVV)
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to implement Artificial Intelligence Test, Evaluation, Validation & Verification (AI TEVV) practices to enable Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT)-related security, resilience and compliance-related conformity testing throughout the lifecycle of the AAT.
compensating_control_2.justification: Artificial Intelligence Test, Evaluation, Validation & Verification (AI TEVV) (AAT-28) provides periodic assessment and assurance that compensates for the absence of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GAI) Identification (AAT-27.1) by providing structured evaluation of the environment to surface gaps and verify residual control effectiveness. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
